workflow_pack_template.intended_use: Agent Builder / Workflow Pack onboarding template and checklist; not a runtime replacement

modules.proof_gate: objective ledger and taskpool acceptance evidence before lifecycle advancement
modules.safe_fixture_boundary: markdown/JSON planning records only; no automatic task lifecycle sync

modules.proof_gate: memory writes require explicit scope and read-back evidence
modules.safe_fixture_boundary: placeholders and policy declarations only; no credential or private-memory write

modules.proof_gate: tool execution must be backed by command/artifact proof and authority boundary
modules.safe_fixture_boundary: toy tool declarations only; no real terminal/code/search/weather/API invocation

modules.proof_gate: RAG/vector retrieval is context only, never taskpool SSOT or proof authority
modules.safe_fixture_boundary: metadata and fixture text only; no vector DB mutation

modules.proof_gate: system/persona changes require scoped diff and verification of consuming surface
modules.safe_fixture_boundary: draft agent-card fields only; no active skill/persona mutation

modules.proof_gate: focused tests or read-only verifier output must be recorded before done/review sync
modules.safe_fixture_boundary: schema/static checks only in this draft

modules.proof_gate: dashboard/lifecycle synchronization cannot treat proof-check as green without clean proof evidence
modules.safe_fixture_boundary: read-only observability checklist; no cron/dashboard mutation

modules.proof_gate: production deploy, remote push/merge, secrets, payment, or permission expansion require human decision
modules.safe_fixture_boundary: deployment checklist only; no deploy files activated

modules.proof_gate: examples must label side effects and cannot masquerade as production tests
documentation claims require artifact path or command proof
modules.safe_fixture_boundary: private draft docs; no external publish

agent_card_template.role: Teach and package a safe Hermes-native Agent Builder scaffold from a beginner Agent project structure.

human_gate_policy.tool_execution: requires explicit task authority, risk classification, and proof command
human_gate_policy.rag_or_vector_write: requires scoped local write authorization and read-back
human_gate_policy.external_dispatch: requires exact adapter, target, payload, idempotency key, and user approval

toy_react_fixture_boundary.execution_policy: documentation/static fixture only; do not run external model service or install dependencies

red_lines: Do not treat the Douyin post as canonical Hermes architecture.
Do not replace taskpool, Mission, Workflow Kernel, proof-check, or evidence gates with a simple ReAct loop.
Do not connect toy terminal/code/search/weather/API tools to real systems without human-gated authority.
Do not use RAG/vector retrieval as source of truth or proof authority.
Do not deploy, push, publish, write secrets, purchase, or send external messages from this scaffold.
